newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury gains in technical trading.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury gains in technical trading.

text.p: Shares in J. Sainsbury Plc rose 7-1/2 pence to 323-1/2 in a technical recovery following recent underperformance by the supermarket chain, market makers said.
The recovery was triggered by comments in The Times newspaper that data from the Institute of Grocery Distribution may show a sharp sales recovery in the retail sector in March, market makers added.

Sainsbury shares traded at around 401 pence mid-January, but fell sharply after, to as low as 308 pence early in March, following a company profit warning and investor fears of a price war among supermarkets.
